# Apple Configuration Profiles Gotchas

> Apple configuration profile (.mobileconfig) generation and signing gotchas.

## Entries

- [Signed Apple configuration profiles: DER CMS SignedData with embedded content, the same signing identity is required to replace an installed profile, and passwords in the profile are readable](signed-profile-format-and-replacement-identity.md): A signed .mobileconfig is DER CMS SignedData with the plist embedded; a renewal that changes the signing identity can block replacing an installed profile; signing does not hide passwords; the Rust `cms` builder copies content into non-zeroizable values and reads the system clock. MEDIUM.
